en.goal_ph: A summary with sources, a short slide deck, a study plan, or a small piece of code
en.goal_hint: 500 characters max · Ctrl+Enter to make the plan
en.home_nota: This is not a full browser, and it does not publish apps. On the free plan it searches, summarizes with sources, and prepares files for you to download.

en.modo_auto_d: Runs all the steps in a row. You can pause any time.
en.pausado: Paused. The next step won't run until you continue.

en.err_vacio: Say what you want done. One sentence is enough.
